§6Upgrade Cards§f modify AE2 block behavior. The family includes §6Basic§f and §6Advanced Cards§f as base tiers, plus specialized variants for specific upgrades.

§6Basic Card§f: Gold Ingots + Iron + Redstone + Calculation Processor. §6Advanced Card§f: same recipe with Diamonds instead of Gold. Shapeless upgrades: Basic + Certus Quartz crystal = §6Capacity Card§f; Advanced + Fluix crystal = §6Speed Card§f.

Key cards: §6Capacity§f (Storage Cell tiers), §6Acceleration§f (Import/Export Bus speed), §6Speed§f (Molecular Assembler speed), §6Crafting§f (Level Emitter trigger), §6Fuzzy§f (OreDict-aware filtering), §6Inverter§f (whitelist/blacklist flip), §6Pattern Expansion§f (Pattern Provider slots), §6Redstone§f (redstone control on parts), §6Sticky§f (keep items when inventory is full).

§ePS:§f Most blocks accept §b4-8 upgrade slots§f. The Inverter Card is underrated, pair it with Fuzzy Mode for OreDict-aware item exclusion.
